headline: Greetings from Trouville-sur-Mer, a beach town little changed since Monet painted it
context: The Normandy beach town of Trouville-sur-Mer is a two-hour train ride from Paris, but feels a world away, with English Channel breezes and the sound of seagulls screeching through the cobbled streets.
